pairing.step1: On the target site: Plugins → install and activate WP Claude Bridge.
pairing.step2: Open Tools → Claude Bridge → Hub Connector Mode.
pairing.step3: Turn connector mode on and enter the “Hub server URL” and “Shared secret” shown above.
